name: Wyrmhole
author: Quinn Painter (quinnp); music and SFX by Coffee Bat; Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
description: Wyrmhole by Quinn Painter, a fast-paced circular space shooter for the Game Boy, created in 7 days for Game Boy Showdown 2022: circle the rim of the wormhole and blast the enemies coming out of its centre. MIT license (github.com/QuinnPainter/Wyrmhole).

descriptions.en: Wyrmhole by Quinn Painter, a fast-paced circular space shooter for the Game Boy, created in 7 days for Game Boy Showdown 2022: circle the rim of the wormhole and blast the enemies coming out of its centre. MIT license (github.com/QuinnPainter/Wyrmhole).
descriptions.it: Wyrmhole di Quinn Painter, uno sparatutto spaziale circolare e frenetico per Game Boy, creato in 7 giorni per la Game Boy Showdown 2022: gira lungo il bordo del wormhole e abbatti i nemici che escono dal centro. Licenza MIT (github.com/QuinnPainter/Wyrmhole).
